excluded_reasons.entity_event_count: cumulative per-entity event counter = position in the stream: monotone in time by construction, so every later window looks out-of-range relative to TRAIN (ML-1: PSI 2.44; ML-2/ML-1: 24% of test rows exceed the TRAIN maximum). It encodes 'how long the stream has run', not behaviour.
